recommended_first_component.scope: Pair control input-to-actual-outcome node-counter lower bounds
inputs: arbitrary pair Control and full pair State
recommended_first_component.result_projection: The actual stored pair State checked.native.machine.heap.nodes.next in all five outcome tags.
recommended_first_component.fixed_result_type: Pair result is the concrete Edge, not an arbitrary Output.
proposed_public_API_kinds: One total full-state projection definition in the new module
recommended_first_component.theorem_instances: Both equality instances inline; no global instance.

accessor_decision.recommended: One public total five-tag outcomeState projection in the new module namespace, returning the existing full pair State. It does not edit an earlier module.
accessor_decision.alternative: Repeat an explicit total five-tag match in each public counter statement. This needs no named accessor, but duplicates the projection in the step and execute statements.
accessor_decision.private_accessor_in_public_type: Reject. It would expose a private name in the public TYPE.

pair_step_cases.call: lookupOrInsert updates only the separate memo field. checked is the original state by record projection.
pair_step_cases.demand: Split the actual FlatMemoThunk observation: absent/evaluate/busy/ready. Every outer checked field is unchanged, including invalid or busy memo states.
pair_step_cases.order: Both numeric-order branches retain the same full state.
pair_step_cases.native: Use H36 step_mono at the actual supplied checked body and checked state. Split the same actual checked step across all five outcomes. Each outer checked field is that exact returned checked state.
pair_step_cases.ret: Split pending as nil or cons. The empty case is done; finishing a pending memo updates only memo.

pair_execute_IH.zero: yielded with the same input state
pair_execute_IH.successor: Derive the first-step bound, split the actual five-tag step, and compose only the yielded branch with predecessor fuel at its exact next control and after state.

later_scan_component.scope: Same unconditional step and execute lower bounds over the actual pair State in all five scan outcomes.
proposed_public_API_kinds: One total full-state projection definition in the new module
later_scan_component.pure_cases: cluster nil/cons and scan nil/cons retain the exact state.
later_scan_component.comparison_case: Use the pair step bound on the same inner control and state. All five actual pair outcomes forward their exact after state. The done branch yields a conditional residual control but still the exact same after state.
later_scan_component.yielded_IH: Generalize scan Control and full pair State over fuel. Recurse only on the exact yielded next/after with predecessor fuel.
later_scan_component.resume_head_not_proposed: There is no existing Scan.resume function.

public_immediate_APIs.projection_equalities: The enclosing memo-only record updates retain checked definitionally. No new Valid or cache-retention theorem is needed.
public_immediate_APIs.conditional_miss_readback_not_used: The existing public miss_readback requires Valid, both misses and observed done. It cannot replace an unconditional outcome bound.

obstructions_and_limits: The exact public projection API must be chosen before statement/body authoring. There is no existing accessor to project silently.
No decreasing actual branch was found in these control definitions. This is a source route, not a new kernel proof.
Strict growth fails for fuel zero and memo-only/list transitions. Whole checked-state equality also fails for actual allocating work.
Later H23 composition must use its actual finite sequence of Scan.execute witnesses and its exact checked execute2 construction, without another run.
An operational before-to-after bound does not derive source.nodes.next <= before.nodes.next. Grows and Kernel.Extension do not supply that counter field.
